blockers.title: PASS audit subject is not bound to current candidate bytes
blockers.effect: A stale passing audit could authorize a regenerated external manifest around mutated candidate files because freeze validation never compares the audit's ten-file subject inventory to current non-audit candidate rows.

next_revision_scope: Require the PASS audit's exact ordered ten-file path/hash/byte subject inventory and aggregate digest to equal current candidate bytes excluding the audit.
Bind that audited-subject digest in the external freeze manifest and run-contract freeze identity.
preservation: Candidate-v7 bytes and this failed audit remain immutable evidence; repair proceeds only in candidate-v8.
